artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adding an opt-in host-scoped gate mutex to task-lock.sh (resolved lock root, base-dir-parameterized named-mutex primitive, gate-acquire-host verb pair, host-outer/repo-inner wiring at all three gate brackets, cross-directory double-start plus degradation coverage, canonical-spec section, redeploy).

memory_candidates.content: Adding a new shell test suite under agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/tests/ requires TWO registration surfaces, both commit-blocking and easy to miss when planning: (1) a row in scripts/tests/suite-classification.data, enforced by lint/lint-unit-integration-boundary.sh which fails loudly on any discovered-but-unclassified suite; and (2) an entry in the extension's manifest.json provides.scripts[] array, which enumerates every test file individually (178 tests/ entries today) and is sync-enforced by test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh. Omitting (2) is the quieter failure: the suite runs fine from the source store but never reaches the deployed .claude/scripts/tests/ directory that Gate 8 actually discovers, so it silently never runs in production. Declare both files in the SAME plan phase that creates the suite, never in a later reconciliation phase.
